# NXGEN Premier League

> NXGEN Premier League is a Philippines-based basketball league featuring four divisions — Rising Stars, Legacy, 3x3, and King of the Court — with live streams, leaderboards, player profiles, and RFID-linked accounts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): League overview, divisions, fixtures, leaderboards, livestream, and sponsors.
- [Register](/register): Sign up for a division as a player or coach.
- [Schedule](/schedule): Upcoming fixtures and game times across all divisions.
- [Standings](/standings): Current team standings for each division.
- [Leaders](/leaders): Top players by PTS, REB, AST, STL, BLK per division.
- [Player Rankings](/rankings): Individual players ranked per game by PTS, REB, AST, STL, BLK, filterable by division.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Game night photos organised by date and division.
- [Development Guide](/development): High school basketball development guide — the path into NXGEN's Rising Stars and Legacy divisions.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy): How we handle player and visitor data.
- [Terms of Service](/legal/terms): Rules for using the site and league services.
- [Waiver](/legal/waiver): Participation waiver for players.
- [Code of Conduct](/legal/code-of-conduct): Expected behavior for players, coaches, and staff.
- [Refund Policy](/legal/refund-policy): Refund and cancellation terms.
